description: Find the scene changes in one of an Editor project's videos: the seconds in the file where the picture cuts, read by ffmpeg. Use them with edit_editor_timeline split_scenes (cut a placed clip at those points) or auto_clip (lay chosen pieces in a row). Free; a long file takes up to a few minutes.

media_id.description: The media item id (read_editor_timeline lists the media).

media_name.description: Or the media item by name.

threshold.description: How big a picture change counts as a cut, 0.1 (every small change) to 0.9 (only hard cuts). Default 0.4.

name: find_editor_scenes
title: Find Editor Scenes
